limits: For white wine, Sauvignon: at most 10%
For red wine, Pinot Noir: 25 to 60%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A small appellation in Auvergne around Saint-Pourçain-sur-Sioule, upstream of the Loire. It makes white, rosé and red wine from Sacy, Chardonnay, Gamay and Pinot Noir, on about 1,500 acres across 19 communes.
